title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the "Maritime Litigation Document Forms (Trial Implementation)" (Continued)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the "Model Forms for Maritime Litigation Documents (For Trial Implementation)"

(Continued from Previous Issue)

Form No. 65

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Civil Judgment

(For Declaring a Ship Free of Maritime Liens)

(XXXX) Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

Applicant: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

The Applicant, XXX, filed an application for a maritime lien warning notice. After accepting the case, this Court issued a public notice on X, XX, XXXX, urging maritime lien claimants to assert their rights within sixty days. The warning period has now expired, and no person has submitted a claim to this Court. Pursuant to Article 126 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. Declare that the vessel "XX," which the Applicant XXX has (or intends to) acquire, shall no longer be subject to any maritime lien;
2. As of the date of the public announcement of this judgment, no person shall assert any maritime lien against the Applicant XXX regarding the vessel "XX."

This judgment is final.

Adjudicator: XXX

X, XX, XXXX

(Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Explanation:

I. This judgment form is to be used by maritime courts when, after accepting a case concerning the maritime lien warning procedure and issuing a public notice urging maritime lien holders to assert their rights, no person asserts their rights within the prescribed period, and the court declares that the ship is free of maritime liens in accordance with the law.

II. In the "Applicant" column, if the applicant is a natural person, the name, gender, date of birth, ethnicity, place of origin, occupation or work unit and position, domicile, etc., shall be stated. If the applicant is a legal person or other organization, the name, domicile, name and position of the legal representative or responsible person shall be stated.

Form No. 66

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Public Notice

(For Declaring a Ship Free of Maritime Liens)

(XXXX) Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

This Court accepted the application for a maritime lien warning notice filed by the Applicant XXX on X, XX, XXXX, and handled the maritime lien warning procedures in accordance with the law for the vessel "XX," which the Applicant has (or intends to) acquire. No person asserted a maritime lien during the warning period. This Court rendered the Civil Judgment (XXXX) Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX on X, XX, XXXX, declaring that the vessel "XX" shall no longer be subject to any maritime lien. As of the date of this public notice, no person shall assert any maritime lien against the Applicant XXX regarding the vessel "XX."

Hereby this public notice is given.

X, XX, XXXX

(Court Seal)

Explanation:

This public notice form is to be used by maritime courts after the expiration of the maritime lien warning period, to publicly announce the judgment of removal of rights declaring that the ship which the applicant has (or intends to) acquire is free of maritime liens.

Form No. 67

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Civil Ruling

(For Terminating Maritime Lien Warning Proceedings)

(XXXX) Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX

Applicant: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

The Applicant, XXX, submitted an application for a maritime lien warning notice to this Court on X, XX, XXXX, on the grounds of ... (state the reason for applying for the maritime lien warning). After accepting the case, this Court issued the Civil Ruling (XXXX) Hai Fa Cui Zi No. XX on X, XX, XXXX, granting the application of the Applicant XXX, and issued a public notice on X, XX, XXXX, urging maritime lien claimants to assert their rights within sixty days. Now, the maritime lien claimant XXX has asserted the maritime lien to this Court within the warning period. Pursuant to relevant legal provisions, it is ruled as follows:

The maritime lien warning proceedings in this case are terminated.

This ruling is final.

Adjudicator: XXX

X, XX, XXXX

(Court Seal)

This document is verified to be identical to the original.

Clerk: XXX

Explanation:

I. This form is to be used in maritime lien warning cases, when a lien claimant asserts their rights, and the maritime lien warning proceedings are terminated.

II. Whether a ruling is used to terminate the maritime lien warning proceedings shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of relevant judicial interpretations.

9. Pleadings Category

Form No. 68

Application for Enforcement of a Maritime Arbitration Award

Respondent: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

To: Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Applicant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Application for Recognition and Enforcement of a Foreign Court Judgment (or Ruling)

Applicant: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Respondent: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Claim: ... (request for recognition and enforcement of a maritime judgment or ruling rendered by a court of Country XX).

Facts and Reasons: ... (state the dispute between the parties, the proceedings in the foreign court, the specific content sought to be recognized and enforced, the legal basis, etc.).

To: Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Attachment: ... (notarized and apostilled original copy of the judgment or ruling and its Chinese translation).

Applicant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Form No. 70

Application for Recognition and Enforcement of a Foreign Maritime Arbitration Award

Applicant: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Respondent: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Claim: ... (state the content of the foreign maritime arbitration award sought to be recognized and enforced).

Facts and Reasons: ... (state the circumstances of the dispute, the arbitral institution, the arbitration proceedings and the arbitral award, as well as the reasons and basis for requesting recognition and enforcement).

To: Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Attachment: ... (notarized and apostilled original copy of the arbitral award and its Chinese translation).

Applicant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Form No. 71

Application for Pre-litigation Arrest of a Ship

Applicant: ... (state name or title, nationality, domicile, and other basic information).

Legal Representative: ... (state name and position).

Respondent: ... (state name or title, nationality, address, and other basic information).

The vessel "XX," owned by the Respondent XXX and ... (state nationality), caused losses to the Applicant in the amount of ... (state actual loss or estimated monetary amount and currency name) due to ... (state the reason for requesting preservation). The said vessel owned by the Respondent is currently docked at Port (Anchorage) XXX, of the People's Republic of China. We hereby apply to your court for its arrest and to order the Respondent to provide security.

The Applicant provides security in the amount of ... (state the name and amount of the security property, etc.). If the Applicant's application is erroneous, causing the Respondent to suffer losses due to the property preservation, the Applicant shall bear the liability for compensation.

To: Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Attachment: ... (evidence of a maritime claim).

Applicant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Explanation:

I. This application form is to be used by a maritime claimant, for the purpose of preserving the exercise of their maritime claim, to apply to a maritime court for property preservation by arresting a specific ship owned by the respondent before filing a lawsuit.

II. When applying for the arrest of a ship, the maritime claimant shall, when submitting the application to the maritime court, provide evidentiary materials supporting the maritime claim as an attachment to the application, and state the names and number of copies of the attachments.

III. A maritime claimant applying for the pre-litigation arrest of cargo or marine fuel oil may refer to this form to draft an application for pre-litigation maritime property preservation.

IV. When drafting the application according to this form, refer to Explanations 2 and 3 of the form for the Application for Litigation Property Preservation.

Form No. 72

Application for Arrest of a Ship During Litigation

Applicant: ... (state name or title, nationality, domicile, etc.).

Legal Representative: ... (state name and position).

Respondent: ... (state name or title, nationality, domicile, etc.).

Legal Representative: ... (state name and position).

The vessel ... (state the port of call, nationality, and vessel name), owned by the Respondent, caused losses to the Applicant in the amount of ... (state actual loss or estimated monetary amount and currency name) due to ... (state the reason for requesting preservation). We hereby apply to your court for the arrest of said vessel and to order the Respondent to provide security.

The Applicant provides security in the amount of ... (state the name and amount of the security property, etc.) (Omit this sentence if no security is provided). If the Applicant's error causes the Respondent to suffer losses due to the property preservation, the Applicant shall bear the liability for compensation.

To: Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Applicant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Explanation:

I. This application form is to be used by a maritime claimant, after filing a maritime lawsuit or concurrently with filing a lawsuit, to apply to a maritime court for property preservation by arresting a specific ship owned by the respondent.

II. If the applicant, respondent (or plaintiff, defendant), or third party is a natural person, state the name, gender, address, etc. There is no item for legal representative.

III. For foreigners in foreign-related maritime cases, their nationality, foreign names, enterprise names, vessel names, place names, country names, etc., shall be written in Chinese. At the same time, except for nationality, the foreign language shall be indicated in parentheses.

IV. Explanations 2 and 3 above also apply to various documents in the category of documents specific to maritime cases.

Form No. 73

Application for Auction of a Ship

Applicant: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Legal Representative: ... (state name and position).

Pursuant to the maritime claim preservation application filed by this Applicant, XXX, on X, XX, XXXX, your court lawfully arrested the vessel "XX" (state Chinese and foreign language name), owned by the Respondent XXX (state name, nationality), and of ... (state vessel registration) nationality, on X, XX, XXXX. Now, due to ... (state the reason for applying for auction), and pursuant to Article 29 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, we hereby apply to your court for the compulsory auction of the vessel "XX" (state vessel name).

To: Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Applicant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Explanation:

I. This application form is to be used by a maritime claimant when applying for the auction of a ship that has already been arrested.

II. For foreigners in foreign-related maritime cases, except for nationality, the foreign language shall be indicated in parentheses.

Form No. 74

Application for a Maritime Injunction

Claimant: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Respondent: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Claim: ... (state the specific content of the act to be performed or refrained from by the respondent).

Facts and Reasons: (state the facts giving rise to the specific maritime claim, the need to correct the respondent's actions violating legal provisions or contractual agreements, the facts of infringement of the claimant's rights and interests, the reasons for urgency, etc.).

To: Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Attachment: ... (relevant evidentiary materials).

Claimant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Form No. 75

Application for Maritime Evidence Preservation

Claimant: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Respondent: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Claim: (state the name of the evidence to be preserved, the method of preservation requested, etc.).

Facts and Reasons: (state the facts of the specific maritime claim, the connection between the evidence requested to be preserved and the maritime claim, the relationship between the respondent and the evidence requested to be preserved, etc.).

To: Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Attachment: ... (relevant evidentiary materials).

Claimant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Form No. 76

Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Maritime Accident Investigation Form

(For Use in Hearing Vessel Collision Cases)

(Cover Page)

Plaintiff (Defendant): XXX (Signature or Seal)

Name of Person Completing Form: XXX Position: XXX

Date of Completion: XXX

(Note: Cover page content occupies one page)

Details of the Maritime Accident and its Course of Events

(Note: The above content is on a separate page)

Instructions for Completing the Form

1. This form shall be completed truthfully and item by item, according to the actual situation and equipment of each vessel, by the master, watchkeeping officer, or other relevant personnel of the vessel involved in the maritime accident at the time of filing or responding to the lawsuit. Any falsification will result in legal liability.
2. Use a fountain pen or brush and Chinese language and characters (if filled in a foreign language, a Chinese translation must be attached). The handwriting must be neat and clear, and the meaning expressed must be unambiguous. Any alterations must be stamped or sealed with a fingerprint.
3. The parties shall, based on the content filled in, provide corresponding evidentiary materials before the trial commences. Any materials in foreign language versions must be accompanied by Chinese translations. Attached are the written evidence to be provided by the vessel involved:
    (1) Certificate of Ownership and Certificate of Nationality of the vessel involved;
    (2) Ship Inspection Certificate and Seaworthiness Certificate of the vessel involved;
    (3) Navigation Log Book and Operating Permit or similar documents of the vessel involved;
    (4) Original records or similar documents of the Deck Log, Engine Log, Engine Order Telegraph Log, Radio Log, Radar Log, etc., of the vessel involved during navigation;
    (5) Compass Deviation Table of the vessel involved and the original nautical charts and automatic heading records used at the time of the collision;
    (6) Certificates of Competency for the Master, Watchkeeping Officer, and Engineer of the vessel involved, as well as the crew list, names, addresses, and corresponding position certificates;
    (7) Documentary evidence of meteorological and hydrological conditions in the waters where the maritime accident occurred;
    (8) Maritime Report or Maritime Protest of the vessel involved;
    (9) Marine Casualty Survey Report of the vessel involved;
    (10) Testimony of witnesses present at the scene of the maritime accident involving the vessel;
    (11) Other evidentiary materials relevant to this case.
    The above evidence shall be provided according to the actual equipment and circumstances of each vessel.

(Note: The "Instructions for Completing the Form" content occupies another page)

Explanation:

I. This investigation form is formulated pursuant to the provisions of Article 82 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. It shall be completed and submitted by the parties and is for use by maritime courts when hearing vessel collision cases.

II. When this investigation form serves as evidence, it shall only be used as a statement of the party.

Form No. 77

Statement of Completion of Evidence Production

(For Use in Hearing Vessel Collision Cases)

To: Maritime Court

XXX (Submitter of the Statement), as the ... (state the litigation status of the party) in Case No. (XXXX) Hai Fa Chu Zi No. XX, has completed the obligation to produce evidence before the commencement of the trial and has submitted the following evidence to the court, while simultaneously applying to inspect the evidentiary materials concerning the facts of the vessel collision. (This sentence may be omitted if no such application is made.)

Hereby this statement is given.

Attachment: ... (list the evidence catalogue).

XXX (Litigation status and name of party, with signature/seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Explanation:

This form is to be filled in by a party after completing all evidence production before the trial commences. It is for use by maritime courts when hearing vessel collision cases.

Form No. 78

Application for Substitution of Party by Subrogation

(For Use by Insurer Filing for Subrogation During Litigation)

To: Maritime Court

Regarding the case of ... (state the parties and the cause of action) pending before your esteemed court, our insurance company, XXX Insurance Company, as the insurer of XXX (state the name of the party), has paid all amounts claimable under the insurance coverage on X, XX, XXXX. In order to exercise the right of subrogation, we hereby apply to your esteemed court for the substitution of the party (or to participate in the litigation as a co-party), to subrogate and exercise the rights of XXX (state the name of the party).

Hereby this application is submitted for your approval.

Attachment: ... (Insurance contract, claim settlement schedule, and payment voucher).

Applicant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Explanation:

I. This form is submitted by an insurer who has obtained the right of subrogation. It is for use by maritime courts and appellate courts when hearing cases.

II. The applicant shall simultaneously submit the insurance contract, claim settlement schedule, and payment voucher with this application.

III. Pursuant to the provisions of Article 95, Paragraph 2 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, an application by an insurer or the insured to participate in the litigation as a co-plaintiff may also refer to this application form, changing the reason for the application to a request to participate in the litigation.

Form No. 79

Application for Adding a Co-defendant for Oil Pollution Damage

To: Maritime Court

In the case of Plaintiff XXX v. Defendant ... (state the parties and the cause of action), the owner of the vessel "XX" ... (state nationality and name), which caused the oil pollution damage, has not been listed as a party. Pursuant to the provisions of Article 97, Paragraph 2 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, we apply to add XXX (state the name of the person to be added) as the ... (state the litigation status after addition) in this case.

Hereby this application is submitted.

Applicant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Explanation:

This form is submitted by an insurer of oil pollution damage or another person providing financial security, when acting as a defendant. It is for use by maritime courts and appellate courts when hearing cases.

Form No. 80

Application for an Order for Payment

Applicant: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Respondent: ... (state name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Claim: Request the Maritime Court to issue an order for payment to the Respondent, ordering the Respondent to pay ... (state the specific amount of money or the name and quantity of negotiable instruments sought to be claimed).

Facts and Reasons: ... (state the process and basis for the formation of the creditor-debtor relationship between the Applicant and the Respondent, and the reasons for demanding payment, etc.).

To: Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China

Attachment: ... (relevant evidentiary materials).

Applicant: XXX (Signature/Seal)

X, XX, XXXX

Explanation:

I. This application form is for a creditor to file an application for an order for payment based on a maritime matter.

II. In the "Applicant" and "Respondent" columns, if the entity is a legal person or other organization, the name, address, and name and position of the legal representative or principal responsible person shall be stated. If the entity is a citizen, the name, gender, date of birth, ethnicity, place of origin, occupation or work unit and position, domicile, etc., shall be stated.

III. In the "Applicant" signature column, if the entity is a legal person or other organization, its full name shall be written, the legal representative or representative shall sign, and the company seal shall be affixed.

Form No. 81

Application for Public Exhortation

Style 82

Application for Establishment of a Fund for Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims

Applicant: ... (specify name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Request: ... (specify the amount of the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims to be established).

Grounds for Request: The vessel owned (or chartered, operated, or insured) by the applicant ... (specify the flag, name, and other basic information of the vessel) suffered a maritime accident at ... (specify the port or sea area name and its latitude and longitude) on ... (date) at ... (time) (or, if the applicant is a salvor, state: "The applicant suffered a maritime accident while salving the vessel ... (specify the flag, name, and other basic information of the vessel) at ... (specify the port or sea area name and its latitude and longitude) on ... (date) at ... (time)"), and has caused economic losses to the following interested persons: ... (specify the names, addresses, and means of communication of the known interested persons).

Pursuant to Article 101 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the applicant hereby applies to establish a fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims.

To the ... Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China.

Attached: ... (relevant evidentiary materials).

Applicant: ... (signature or seal)

... (date)

Style 83

Letter of Guarantee

(for providing guarantee for the establishment of a fund)

Guarantor: ... (specify name, domicile, and other basic information).

Principal: ... (specify name, domicile, and other basic information).

At the request of the principal ..., the guarantor ... provides a guarantee for the principal's establishment of a fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims in respect of the accident involving the vessel "..." on ... (date). The guaranteed amount is the fund amount determined in Civil Ruling No. ... (...), ... (year), ... (case abbreviation) of the ... Maritime Court ... (specify currency type and amount), plus interest accrued during the period of fund establishment. The guarantor ... undertakes that, when the court distributes the fund, the guarantor will, upon notice from the court, remit the above amount in a lump sum to the designated account.

To the ... Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China.

Guarantor: ... (seal)

Legal Representative: ... (signature)

... (date)

Note:

This form is for use by a guarantor providing a guarantee for the principal to establish a fund for limitation of liability.

Style 84

Application for Establishment of a Fund for Limitation of Liability for Oil Pollution Damage

Applicant: ... (specify name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Request: ... (specify the amount of the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims to be established).

Grounds for Request: The vessel owned (or chartered, operated, or insured) by the applicant ... (specify the flag, name, and other basic information of the vessel) caused oil pollution damage at ... (specify the port or sea area name and its latitude and longitude) on ... (date) at ... (time), and has caused economic losses to the following interested persons: ... (specify the names, addresses, and means of communication of the known interested persons).

Pursuant to Article 101 of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the applicant hereby applies to establish a fund for limitation of liability for oil pollution damage.

To the ... Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China.

Attached: ... (relevant evidentiary materials).

Applicant: ... (signature or seal)

... (date)

Style 85

Objection

Objector: ... (specify name or title, nationality, domicile, and other basic information).

Objection: ...

Facts and Grounds for Objection: ... (specify the specific facts and legal basis on which the objection to the applicant's establishment of a fund or the amount of the fund is based).

To the ... Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China.

Attached: ... (relevant evidentiary materials).

Objector: ... (signature or seal)

... (date)

Note:

I. This form is for use when lodging an objection to an application by a person liable for a maritime accident to establish a fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims.

II. When lodging an objection, the objector shall attach relevant evidentiary materials.

Style 86

Application for Registration of Claims

Applicant: ... (specify name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

Request: ... (specify the nature, amount, etc. of the claim to be registered).

Facts and Grounds: ... (the facts showing that the claim to be registered relates to the vessel sold by auction or to a maritime accident occurring on a specific occasion, the basis for the establishment of the claim, and the reasons for applying for registration of the claim).

To the ... Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China.

Applicant: ... (signature or seal)

... (date)

Note:

I. This form is for use by a creditor whose claim relates to a vessel sold by auction or to a maritime accident occurring on a specific occasion when applying for registration of the claim.

II. If the applicant is a citizen, fill in the name, sex, date of birth, ethnicity, place of origin, occupation or work unit and position, domicile, etc.; if the applicant is a legal person or other organization, fill in the name, domicile, name and position of the legal representative or responsible person.

Style 87

Application for Advertisement for Maritime Liens

Applicant: ... (specify name or title, domicile, and other basic information).

The applicant has (or intends to) acquire the vessel "..." . This vessel ... (specify the ownership, basic technical data, etc.). For the purpose of urging holders of maritime liens to assert their rights in a timely manner and to extinguish the maritime liens attached to the vessel, the applicant, pursuant to the relevant provisions of the Special Maritime Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, hereby applies for an advertisement for maritime liens and requests that this application be granted.

To the ... Maritime Court of the People's Republic of China.

Attached: ... (vessel transfer contract, vessel technical data).

Applicant: ... (signature or seal)

... (date)

Note:

I. This form is for use in applying for the procedure of advertisement for maritime liens.

II. If the applicant is a citizen, fill in the name, sex, date of birth, ethnicity, place of origin, occupation or work unit and position, domicile, etc.; if the applicant is a legal person or other organization, fill in the name, domicile, name and position of the legal representative or responsible person.

(End)
